text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: High GPU allocation queue growth in gcp-europe-west9. Autoscaler failing to attach GPUs due to project quota limits. Severity: P1. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-quotahit

michelle_oncall: on it. any visible customer impact yet?

aaron_sre: metrics: queue depth -> 860 requests (5m avg up 6x), token throughput down 35%, 5xx spike -> 11% for generation-api-eu prefix. logs show attach errors: 
```
E0321 12:34:56 attach.go:142] Attach failed: googleapi: Error 403: Quota 'NVIDIA_TESLA_GPUS' exceeded for project redwood-prod-eu-west9, quotaExceeded
```

lina_infra: confirmed with cloud console: GPU quota exhausted in europe-west9 (project: redwood-prod). No regional spare capacity. I've pulled the quota history- spike started ~11:50 UTC.

raj_support: tickets: multiple enterprise customers reporting degraded latency and failures for embeddings. ETA on mitigation? Customers asking for SLA status.

olivia_prodops: immediate mitigation plan: 1) enable cross-region fallback for new allocations to gcp-europe-west1, 2) throttle non-critical background jobs, 3) apply temporary per-tenant concurrency caps. Who can kick off fallback routing?

michelle_oncall: @lina_infra can you toggle fallback? if it's manual need exact command/PR. Also open a quota increase with GCP and share ticket ID.

lina_infra: executing fallback now. running: 
```
# route policy update
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/route-policies -d '{"match":"region=europe-west9","action":"fallback:europe-west1","ttl":300}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN'
```
Applied policy, pushing to edge. Verifying pool attachments...

incident-bot: Update: route policy rollout 40% -> requests being accepted in europe-west1. Some cold-start latency expected while new pools warm.

aaron_sre: rolling out temporary model-quantized variant on remaining eu nodes to free GPU space for latency-sensitive traffic. Command: `./deploy canary quantized-v1 --region europe-west9 --weight 0.3`

raj_support: posted interim status to affected customers: "We're experiencing GPU allocation delays in EU region; fallback routing to nearby region is in progress, some requests may see increased latency. We will update ASAP." :thumbsup:

michelle_oncall: created GCP quota ticket: case 123456789 — request +50 GPUs in europe-west9, submitted with priority. GCP response ETA ~2-4 hours per SLA. Also raised to RM.

olivia_prodops: reduce background batch jobs? @aaron_sre can you push a short-term config change to lower batch_workers in prod to 20% until quota fixed.

aaron_sre: done. `prod-config: batch_workers=0.2` rolled to 100% (hot). Should free ~120 GPUs worth of load over next 10m.

lina_infra: small note: some dedicated customers pinned to europe-west9 will still fail until quota increased or we migrate them. I'll compile list and coordinate migrations after incident.

michelle_oncall: handoff note for night oncall @aaron_sre: please continue monitoring queue depth and quota ticket. If queue > 500 for 15m escalate to eng-infra pager.

incident-bot: :hourglass: Next automated check in 5m.

aaron_sre: monitoring. current queue -> 420 (down from 860). 5xx -> 6%. fallback routing handling ~55% of new allocations.

michelle_oncall: good progress. action items logged: (1) follow up GCP ticket (lina) (2) migrate pinned dedicated customers / communicate ETA (lina+raj) (3) postmortem + capacity planning (olivia). Assigning owners in incident tracker.

raj_support: I'll update customer comms with ETA ~3 hours and note mitigation steps.

olivia_prodops: postmortem owners: olivia_prodops (lead), aaron_sre (runtime), lina_infra (quota & provisioning).

incident-bot: Incident P1 acknowledged, actions in progress. Last update recorded at 6480002200. :white_check_mark:
